Interface LegacyConfiguration

All Superinterfaces:
AntBuilderAware, Buildable, Configuration, FileCollection, HasAttributes, HasConfigurableAttributes<Configuration>, Iterable<File>, Named
@Incubating public interface LegacyConfiguration extends Configuration
A Configuration with a mutable role, that can potentially perform behavior of a ConsumableConfiguration, a ResolvableConfiguration, or a DependencyScopeConfiguration.
